column1: 21892§lawsuit§ˈlɔːsuːt§The lawsuit is very much on the lawyer's mind.§律师的脑子里一直浮想着这起**诉讼**。§
21893§pack§pæk§The canteen was absolutely packed.§餐厅**挤满**了人。§
21894§prescribe§prɪˈskraɪb§Doctors diagnose before they prescribe a drug.§医生在**开药**前要先对病人进行诊断。§

21895§universe§ˈjuːnɪvɜːs§Not only did the rocket solve a problem that had intrigued man for ages, but, more importantly, it literally opened the door to exploration of the universe.§火箭不仅解决了困扰几代人的一个问题，更重要的是，它开启了探索**宇宙**的大门。§
21896§skull§skʌl§The anthropologist unearthed the skull of an ancient human at the site.§人类学家在该遗址挖掘出一个古人类的**头骨**。§
21897§domination§ˌdɒmɪˈneɪʃn§The two companies are fighting for the domination of the market.§这两家公司在争夺对市场的**控制权**。§
21898§animate§ˈænɪmət§A smile suddenly animated her face through hearing the good news.§听到这个好消息，她突然笑了，脸上顿时**有了生气**。§改译文：原译「浮现出了笑容」括不出 animate（使有生气），改译
21899§accountancy§əˈkaʊntənsi§He has worked in accountancy since he graduated from university.§他大学毕业后一直从事**会计工作**。§改例句：since 引导的时间状语要用现在完成时，works 改 has worked
21900§availability§əˌveɪləˈbɪləti§Free Water Served is subject to availability.§**视供应情况**提供免费茶水。§改译文：原译文没译出 subject to availability，加「视供应情况」
21901§payable§ˈpeɪəbl§Our company was asked for a 10% deposit payable in advance.§我们公司需要**预付**10%的定金。§改例句：was asked a deposit 缺介词 for
21902§solicitor§səˈlɪsɪtə(r)§Solicitors in Australia are very popular.§**事务律师**在澳大利亚很受欢迎。§
21903§departure§dɪˈpɑːtʃə(r)§The local people had received no news of him since his departure from hometown.§自从他**离开**家乡之后，乡亲们就没有听到过他的消息。§
21904§audit§ˈɔːdɪt§It is a busy time for him that he has to audit the accounts of company A.§这段时间他很忙，需要**审计**A公司的账目。§
21905§receipt§rɪˈsiːt§It is a common rule that goods will be delivered on receipt of payment.§只有在**收到**货款后才可以交货，这是一条普遍的规则。§改译文：on receipt of 是「收到…后」，「支付」改「收到」
21906§scamper§ˈskæmpə(r)§I shouted for help and the dog scampered off.§我大声喊救命，狗便**跑开**了。§
21907§spiral§ˈspaɪrəl§A spiral of smoke rose from the chimney.§烟囱里的烟**袅袅**升起。§
21908§encode§ɪnˈkəʊd§Engineers need to encode the message into computer language.§工程师需要将信息**转化**为计算机语言。§
21909§scout§skaʊt§Both my brothers were scouts and I really want to join the scout troop.§我的两个哥哥都曾是**童子军**成员，我也很想加入童子军。§
21910§regurgitate§rɪˈɡɜːdʒɪteɪt§The cormorant regurgitates half-digested fish to feed its young.§鸬鹚将消化了一半的鱼**回翻**，喂给幼鸟。§
21911§propellant§prəˈpelənt§A rocket motor's "bullets" are minute, high-speed particles produced by burning propellants.§火箭发动机的“子弹”是微小的高速粒子，由**推进剂**的燃烧产生。§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
21912§ejection§ɪˈdʒekʃn§The reaction to the ejection of these small particles inside the rocket causes the rocket to move forwards.§**喷出**这些火箭内部颗粒的反作用力使得火箭向前运动。§
21913§intrigue§ɪnˈtriːɡ§A good teacher knows how to intrigue his students to learn.§好老师懂得如何**激发**学生的学习兴趣。§
21914§transition§trænˈzɪʃn§The transition from planned economy to market economy is not an easy one.§从计划经济向市场经济**转变**并非易事。§
21915§stack§stæk§Dishes are stacked up in a drying rack.§盘子被**堆放**在一个烘干架上。§

21916§realm§relm§It is strange that the rocket was generally ignored by writers of fiction to transport their heroes to mysterious realms beyond the Earth, even though it had been commonly used in fireworks displays in China since the thirteenth century.§尽管从13世纪起火箭就已经普遍应用在了中国的烟花表演中，奇怪的是，小说作者却很少会用火箭将他们的主人公带到地球以外的神秘**地域**。§

21917§ingredient§ɪnˈgriːdiənt§Some time in the tenth century, black powder was first compounded from its basic ingredients of saltpeter, charcoal and sulphur.§10世纪的某个时候，黑火药第一次由硝石、木炭和硫磺这些基本**成分**混制而成。§改例句：tenth century 前缺冠词 the
21918§friction§ˈfrɪkʃn§Studies of primitive societies suggest that the earliest method of making fire was through friction.§有关史前社会的研究表明，**摩擦**取火是最早的取火方式。§
21919§astronaut§ˈæstrənɔːt§The rocket transported the astronauts to mysterious realms beyond the Earth.§火箭将**宇航员**运载到地球以外的神秘领域。§
21920§banner§ˈbænə(r)§On the wall is the banner welcoming the friends of Italian Opera.§墙上挂着一条欢迎意大利歌剧团的朋友们的**横幅**。§
21921§technique§tekˈniːk§A new style of architecture was made possible by new materials and construction techniques.§新的建筑材料和建筑**技术**使新的建筑风格得以实现。§
21922§squeeze§skwiːz§I made the toast and squeezed orange juice every morning.§我每天早上都烤面包、**榨**橙汁。§
21923§sorrow§ˈsɒrəʊ§Carolyn's eyes filled with sorrow at thinking of how she had treated Kevin and lost him forever.§想到自己那样对待凯文并永远地失去了他，卡罗琳的眼中充满了**悲伤**。§
21924§arboreal§ɑːˈbɔːriəl§Koala is an arboreal animal.§树袋熊是一种**树栖**动物。§
21925§facade§fəˈsɑːd§Preserving historic buildings or keeping only their facades grew common.§对历史建筑或对它们的**正面外观**的保护变得越来越普遍。§
21926§post-mortem§ˌpəʊst ˈmɔːtəm§When businesses fail, the post-mortem analysis is traditionally undertaken by accountants and market strategists.§生意失败后，通常是由会计师和市场战略家来进行**事后**分析。§

21927§disillusionment§ˌdɪsɪˈluːʒnmənt§Disillusionment at the failure of many poor imitations of Modernist architecture led to interest in various styles and ideas from the past and present.§这种对现代主义建筑风格模仿的失败引起了建筑师们的**觉醒**，继而激发了他们对过去和现在多重风格和理念的兴趣。§
21928§subject§ˈsʌbdʒɪkt§I'm giving some thoughts to a new book on a different subject.§我在构思一本不同**题材**的新书。§
21929§blunt§blʌnt§The bad weather has blunted our enthusiasm for camping.§坏天气**打击**了我们去露营的热情。§
21930§statistically§stəˈtɪstɪkli§If that information is statistically valid, we can find out what the majority of students prefer.§如果**统计**数据可靠的话，我们就可以找出大多数学生所喜欢的（课程）。§
21931§switch§swɪtʃ§A switch was flipped and the machine began to whirl at 300 revolutions per minute.§按下**开关**，机器开始以每分钟300转的速度旋转。§
21932§stockpile§ˈstɒkpaɪl§The owner of the factory intended to build up his stockpile of raw materials.§该厂主打算增加原料**库存**。§
21933§indicate§ˈɪndɪkeɪt§Evidence gathered in recent years indicates that the region has supported a series of indigenous cultures for eleven thousand years.§近年来收集到的证据**表明**，这一地区有过持续一万一千多年的土著文明。§
21934§uncertainty§ʌnˈsɜːtnti§These fluctuations of environment add another degree of uncertainty to the survival of many species.§这些环境变化给很多物种的生存带来了另一种**不确定性**。§
21935§hypothesis§haɪˈpɒθəsɪs§You have to discard or modify your hypothesis if shown not to be correct.§如果被证实不正确，你就必须放弃或修改你的**假设**。§
21936§ultraclean§ˌʌltrəˈkliːn§They decided to put superclean coal and ultraclean coal into the production.§他们决定在生产中使用超纯精煤和**超净**煤。§
21937§trim§trɪm§The top of the can is trimmed and then bent over to secure the lid.§罐子的顶部经过**修整**后微微向上隆起以便固定好盖子。§
21938§steady§ˈstedi§The van is making steady progress through the dark night.§货车在黑夜中**平稳**行驶。§
21939§dramatic§drəˈmætɪk§The changes in China's Pearl River Delta are more dramatic than these natural fluctuations.§中国珠江三角洲的变化比这些自然界的变化更**巨大**。§
21940§amorphous§əˈmɔːfəs§The Swedish chemist called Pasch discovered amorphous phosphorus.§瑞典化学家帕施发现了**无定形**磷。§
21941§solve§sɒlv§Technology alone cannot solve the problem of vehicle pollution.§仅仅靠技术不可能**解决**机动车辆带来的污染问题。§
21942§blade§bleɪd§The rotating blades can shave away the wax that covers each cell.§旋转的**刀片**可以刮掉附在每个蜂房内壁上的蜂蜡。§
21943§glimpse§glɪmps§We glimpsed the profile of the church steeple against the last glow of the sunset.§我们**瞥见**了在最后一抹晚霞映衬下的教堂尖顶的轮廓。§
21944§bulletin§ˈbʊlətɪn§Tom is going for some news bulletins.§汤姆正在寻找一些新闻**简报**。§
21945§annoy§əˈnɔɪ§The bathroom light which flickered quite badly annoyed me very much.§浴室里的灯闪来闪去，真让我**心烦**。§
21946§chapel§ˈtʃæpl§Jack was the organist in the Octagon Chapel in the city of Bath.§杰克是巴斯市八角**教堂**的风琴师。§
21947§subscribe§səbˈskraɪb§Which magazines did your father subscribe to?§你父亲**订阅**了哪些杂志？§
21948§foil§fɔɪl§The freezer is filled with foil-wrapped packages.§冷藏室里塞满了用**箔纸**包裹着的东西。§
21949§invoice§ˈɪnvɔɪs§The manufacturer invoiced me for two computers.§厂商给我开了一张两台电脑的**发票**。§
21950§extra§ˈekstrə§Today, almost all companies have employees work overtime rather than hire extra personnel.§如今，几乎所有的公司宁愿让员工加班也不愿意雇用**额外**的职员。§改例句：英文句中的中文逗号改为英文逗号
21951§transmute§trænzˈmjuːt§The alchemist tried to transmute iron into gold.§炼金术士试图将铁**变成**黄金。§
21952§analyse§ˈænəlaɪz§The objective of the Human Genome Project is to map and analyse every single gene within the double helix of humanity's DNA.§人类基因工程的目标就是绘制和**分析**人类呈双螺旋状的DNA中的每一个基因。§
21953§acoustic§əˈkuːstɪk§In the houses near the highway special acoustic seals should be fitted to the doors to reduce noise.§位于公路旁的住房的房门上应该安装专门的**隔音**封条，以降低噪音。§
21954§stall§stɔːl§Remember to visit the souvenir stalls in the car park in front of the main entrance to the stadium.§记得到体育馆正门前停车场内的纪念品**小店**看看。§
21955§cover§ˈkʌvə(r)§The study covered 500 employees in four large companies.§这次研究的对象**涉及**四家大公司的500名雇员。§
21956§breakthrough§ˈbreɪkθruː§A brilliant intellectual breakthrough does not ensure that the transition is made from theory to practice.§重大的学术**突破**并不能保证从理论到实践的成功转变。§
21957§spiritual§ˈspɪrɪtʃuəl§Human spiritual needs should match material affluence.§人类的**精神**需求应该与物质富足相匹配。§
21958§concrete§ˈkɒŋkriːt§The old wooden bridge across the river was replaced by a concrete bridge that can carry heavy lorries.§河上的旧木桥被一座能承载重型卡车的**混凝土**桥取代了。§补例句
21959§generalise§ˈdʒenrəlaɪz§It's impossible to generalise about children's books, as they are all different.§儿童读物差别很大，很难**概括**。§
